goal: API security review: authorisation per operation, rate limits, input limits and error exposure.
use: API security review: authorisation per operation, rate limits, input limits and error exposure. Use when code exposes endpoints to other systems or the public.

steps.note: List operations. Each endpoint, method and who may call it.
Check authorisation. Flag operations with no check or a weaker check than their peers.
Check rate and size limits. Flag endpoints with no limit on requests or payloads.
Check errors. Flag responses that expose stack traces or internal ids.
Report. Each operation with file and line, severity and the fix.
